title: RES↔BACK-001: API/Broker Impact of Novel Data Types + Cloud Feasibility for Research
description: The Researcher provides novel data-type specifications (schema, units, expected volume, expected velocity), communication-paradigm proposals (non-standard device-to-cloud patterns — QoS, topic structure, message sequencing), device-interaction pattern proposals, and backend-relevant Technology Transfer Packs; the Backend/Cloud Engineer provides API (Application Programming Interface) and broker impact assessment, device-twin schema impact analysis, cloud-side feasibility feedback (latency, throughput, scaling), and telemetry-schema compatibility assessment. Grounded in IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.13. The authoritative per-field telemetry schema is owned by the Data Engineer (Git-based registry); novel fields requiring registration route through DATA, not duplicated here.

novel_data_specifications.description: RES→BACK: novel data types, communication paradigms, device-interaction patterns.

unit.description: Explicit unit per physical field (units rule §3.10); use 'enum'/'bool'/'string' for non-physical fields.

backend_feasibility.description: BACK→RES: API/broker impact, device-twin impact, cloud feasibility, telemetry compatibility.

scaling_implications.description: Implications against fleet scale (SCALE-1 50,000 devices; SCALE-3 10,000 msgs/s MQTT).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine API/broker impact and cloud-feasibility assessment for research data types is agent-autonomous (API/broker impact within 15 business days; device-twin schema impact within 10 business days). A breaking telemetry-schema change routes through the DATA-owned registry; a flow exceeding SCALE-3 throughput requires load validation before it is accommodated.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (API/broker impact assessment within 15 business days; device-twin schema impact within 10 business days; backend-relevant findings transferred at the quarterly Technology Transfer Review; ad hoc consultation with 5 business days' notice)
confirm_conditions: each novel data type's physical fields carry units; expected volume and velocity carry units
the API/broker impact verdict is stated; REQUIRES_CHANGES enumerates the changes
device-twin schema impact (new fields, provisioning-flow change) is assessed
cloud-feasibility latency and throughput carry explicit units
reject_conditions: a novel data field, volume, or velocity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a telemetry-schema change presented as compatible when it breaks the Data-Engineer-owned registry (must route through DATA)
a proposed data flow exceeding SCALE-3 (10,000 msgs/s) or driving > SCALE-1 (50,000 devices) presented as accommodated without load validation
counter_conditions: a novel data type implies a new telemetry field — request DATA telemetry-schema registration before backend commitment (DATA owns the schema)
a communication-paradigm proposal lacks QoS or topic structure — request these before assessing broker impact
